title: BPW-2026-0513
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0513
BPW
CD ALL
CORRECTION TO JOURNAL
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE a clerical and administrative correction to the Official Journal of June 26, 2026, for item BPW-2026-0326, to accurately reflect the verbal amendment made on the floor by President Kang and adopted by the Board:
CONSIDER the non-submittal of the Schedule A’s a minor, waivable defect; and
FIND Valley Vista Services, Inc. and Ware Disposal, Inc. to be a responsive bidder.
(REF: BPW-2026-0326)
summary: Approval of clerical correction to Official Journal of June 26, 2026 regarding Board decision on responsive bidders.
